itemRecords: Fields enriched from decoded .fmx item records (prompt, item name, column binding, max length, format mask, value lists, canvas position, database-item flag); buttons from item labels. Fields bind to items only by the item prompt, a label that spells the column or item name, or a long item-name prefix; audit-stamp items are excluded.
menuShape: Legacy menu groups are flattened into the module when the module's menu screenshot lists the screens instead of the groups. A group with no options in MENUMASTER stays as a disabled card: 'No options in the legacy menu'.
layout: Tabs and field placement come from the decoded .fmx layout: each item record points to its block, canvas and tab page, and each tab page carries its legacy label; a canvas lists its tab pages in display order. Items on no canvas are hidden in the running form and are not shown as fields. Every tab and field records its source: form+screenshot, form (legacy form only), screenshot (no item in the legacy form file) or screenshot-hidden (the SSA_MSS copy hides the item).
sections: Pages are laid out like the legacy screen: sections are the form's boxes titled by the text on their top edge, fields keep their legacy rows and columns, and labels are the screenshot text beside each field (the form's spelling where the OCR text is only a misreading of it).
